title: LPST rank holder M. Jayakrishnan ends hunger strike over health concerns, launches sharp attack on Keralam government

ai.summary: LPST rank holders in Kerala ended M. Jayakrishnan's hunger strike due to health concerns, criticizing the state government's handling of delayed appointments and police actions.

facts.claim: M. Jayakrishnan ended his indefinite hunger strike citing serious health concerns
facts.quote: M. Jayakrishnan, one of the leaders of the ongoing agitation by Lower Primary School Teacher (LPST) rank holders in front of the Secretariat, called off his indefinite hunger strike citing serious health concerns on Friday (November 20).

facts.claim: The rank holders have been demanding expedited appointments from the existing Kerala Public Service Commission (PSC) rank list
facts.quote: The rank holders have been demanding expedited appointments from the existing Kerala Public Service Commission (PSC) rank list.

facts.claim: Mr. Jayakrishnan began his indefinite hunger strike on November 12 after the police removed the protesters’ temporary shelter outside the Secretariat and forcibly shifted S. Valarmathi, secretary of the All Kerala LPST Rank Holders’ Association, to hospital
facts.quote: Mr. Jayakrishnan began his indefinite hunger strike on November 12 after the police removed the protesters’ temporary shelter outside the Secretariat and forcibly shifted S. Valarmathi, secretary of the All Kerala LPST Rank Holders’ Association, to hospital.

facts.claim: He criticized the government’s response towards their demands and questioned the assurances given to the rank holders
facts.quote: He criticised the government’s response towards their demands and questioned the assurances given to the rank holders.

facts.claim: He pointed out that the government’s assurance regarding the extension of the rank list had not received the necessary approval from the PSC
facts.quote: he pointed out that the government’s assurance regarding the extension of the rank list had not received the necessary approval from the PSC.

facts.claim: Referring to Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan’s reported emotional response when Ms. Valarmathi had tonsured her head during the agitation, Mr. Jayakrishnan rather sarcastically said he did not want the Chief Minister to be distressed again
facts.quote: Referring to Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan’s reported emotional response when Ms. Valarmathi had tonsured her head during the agitation, Mr. Jayakrishnan rather sarcastically said he did not want the Chief Minister to be distressed again

facts.claim: He questioned the government’s decision to seek another week to resolve the issue
facts.quote: He also questioned the government’s decision to seek another week to resolve the issue.

facts.claim: Former General Education Minister V. Sivankutty has extended his support to the ongoing protest by LPST rank holders
facts.quote: Former General Education Minister V. Sivankutty has extended his support to the ongoing protest by LPST rank holders.

facts.claim: He accused the government of failing to adopt a clear decision on their demand for appointments
facts.quote: He accused the government of failing to adopt a clear decision on their demand for appointments.

ai.background_note: LPST rank holders in Kerala have been protesting since July 2026 over delayed appointments, leading to a hunger strike that was taken over by M. Jayakrishnan after the police removed their shelter and hospitalized the leader.
